name: Sunbeam Fostering Agency
basis: Up to £700 per child per week; ceiling only, no minimum stated. Page also gives annual indications: one child with additional needs up to £36,400 pa; parent and child up to £33,540 pa (based on 2021 payments). Page does not say whether the £700 includes the child's maintenance allowance; it describes the payment as allowance element plus reward element.
depends_on: Child's needs (complex needs, parent and child, remand attract higher rates); each placement assessed individually
quote: Sunbeam offers a generous fostering allowance per week, with payments of up to £700 per child, depending on the children's needs.

name: Caritas Care
basis: £405.00 to £642.00 per full week per child, paid weekly; birthday, holiday and religious festival allowances paid separately on top. Page does not state whether the figure splits into child allowance and carer fee. Allowances reviewed yearly.
depends_on: Not stated on the page (no age, level or needs criteria given)
quote: Our allowances are paid weekly and range from £405.00 to £642.00 per full week per child.

name: UK Fostering
basis: Weekly allowance per child from £377*; page is an older blog and the asterisk note says allowances have since been regularly increased. The figure is a combined payment: it 'includes payment for each carer's skills and commitment' and the child's maintenance costs (clothes, food, pocket money, leisure, school transport). Birthday, festival and respite payments on top.
depends_on: Child's circumstances: significantly higher for a child remanded into care or a child with special needs
quote: paid a weekly allowance, per child, ranging from £377* per week

name: Action for Children (England example)
basis: Illustrative example only: weekly fee £700 + weekly allowance £190 = £890, for a parent and child arrangement. Fee and allowance combined (allowance covers food, clothing, toiletries, day-to-day living). Page states figures are for illustration and individual fees and allowances will vary. Not a standard single-child rate.
depends_on: Location, type of fostering, siblings, complex needs (specialist add-on payments); 'many factors'
quote: Weekly fee £700 + weekly allowance £190 = weekly payment: £890.

name: Action for Children (Scotland example)
basis: Illustrative example only: weekly fee £570 + weekly allowance £199 = £769 for one foster child under 16. Fee and allowance combined. Page states individual fees and allowances will vary.
depends_on: Location, type of fostering, siblings, complex needs; child's age shown only in the example
quote: Weekly fee £570 + weekly allowance £199 = weekly payment: £769.

name: Action for Children (Northern Ireland example)
basis: Illustrative example only: weekly fee £476 + weekly allowance £166 = £642 for one foster child with special needs. Fee and allowance combined. Page states individual fees and allowances will vary.
depends_on: Location, type of fostering, siblings, complex needs; special needs shown in the example
quote: Weekly fee £476 + weekly allowance £166 = weekly payment: £642.

name: Action for Children (Wales example)
basis: NOT per child: illustrative example of weekly fee £456 + weekly allowance £717 = £1,173 for TWO foster siblings aged 16+. Recorded for completeness; do not use as a per-child figure. The £717 allowance is out of line with the other examples and may be an error on the page.
depends_on: Location, type of fostering, siblings, complex needs
quote: Weekly fee £456 + weekly allowance £717 = weekly payment: £1,173.

name: Parallel Parents
basis: Up to £500 per week per child; page also says roughly £20,000 per annum paid weekly, with a level system adding roughly an extra £1,000 per child per annum for experience. Page does not say whether the figure includes the child's allowance.
depends_on: Carer's experience/level (training), child's specific needs, number of children
quote: up to £500 per week, per child you look after

name: Team Fostering
basis: £554.12 per week (£28,814.25 per year) for a child aged 11 and over; rate for under-11s not stated; higher rate where a child is assessed as having additional difficulties (amount not given). Payments not reduced for additional children (two children aged 12 and 14 = £57,628.48 per year). Page refers to 'Carer Fees' and says carers cover food, clothing, transport and activities from the payment; does not explicitly state an allowance/fee split.
depends_on: Child's age; child's assessed additional difficulties
quote: carers receiving £554.12 per week for children aged 11 and over

name: Little Acorns Fostering
basis: Standard weekly fostering allowance £440 per child; can increase up to £900 per week depending on the child's needs and placement type; parent and child placements start from £700 per week. Page says the allowance 'covers all child-related costs' but does not state a separate fee/allowance split. Agency based in Haverhill, Suffolk.
depends_on: Child's needs; type of fostering placement (parent and child from £700)
quote: Our foster carers receive a standard weekly fostering allowance of £440 per child.

name: Mosaic Foster Care
basis: £600 per week minimum, increasing to £700+ per week after completing training (upper figure is open-ended '£700+'). Full payment for each additional child. Page says allowances and fees 'are combined into one' payment at Mosaic. £250 per week retainer for up to 4 weeks after a placement of 6+ months ends. Offices in Southend-on-Sea and Northampton.
depends_on: Carer's completion of training; number of children
quote: £600 per week minimum, increasing to £700+ per week after completing training.

name: Sparks Fostering
basis: Up to £750 per child per week; page says the current average is £750, for carers (qualified childcare professionals) looking after teenagers with additional needs; set at 50% of the local authority fee. Plus around £1,300 per year in additional allowances. Page says fees and allowances 'are paid together and rarely split into two payments'. Fee comparison dated October 2024; agency covers England, comparison focuses on the North West.
depends_on: Carer's qualifications; teenagers with additional needs; linked to the local authority fee
quote: Sparks Fostering – up to £750 (current average is £750 to care for teens with additional needs)

name: Fostering UK
basis: £400-700 per week per child depending on the type of placement. Presented as a per-child weekly allowance covering the child's care (food, clothing, activities); page does not state a fee/allowance split. Homepage describes the organisation as recruiting and supporting its own 'therapeutic foster care specialists' (Peterborough, Buckinghamshire, Milton Keynes, Luton, Watford); Ofsted registration not stated on the pages fetched, so verify it is an IFA before use.
depends_on: Type of placement; child's age and circumstances; higher allowance for ASD, disabilities or special behavioural needs
quote: which at Fostering UK will range from £400-700 per week per child, depending on the type of placement.

name: Clifford House Fostering
basis: Three carer grades, each with a range by child's age, per week per child: Grade 1 (new) £407.68-£494.62; Grade 2 (after 12 months and core training) £417.69-£503.63; Grade 3 (3+ years) £427.70-£514.64. Page says the weekly payment comprises two elements, a child allowance and a professional fee, so the figures are the combined total. Page also says 'up to £25,991 per child each year'. Agency based in Bromsgrove, Worcestershire.
depends_on: Child's age (lower figure younger children, higher older); carer's grade/experience
quote: Depending on the age of the child in your care, you'll receive between £407.68 and £494.62 per week, per child.

name: Apex Fostering
basis: Minimum £500 per week tax-free for one child (body text); the FAQ on the same page says 'a minimum of £450 per week' - the page does not reconcile the two. Can increase to £1000 per week for children with more complex needs. Page does not say whether the figure includes the child's allowance, only that pay is intended to cover the child's costs. Plus two extra weeks' payment per year for holidays. Operates in East/North London, Beds, Bucks, Cambs, Herts, Essex, Lincs, Northants, Peterborough.
depends_on: Child's needs / level of care required; type of placement
quote: With Apex Fostering, foster carers receive a minimum of £500 per week, tax-free, for caring for one child.

name: Olive Branch Fostering
basis: Allowances start from £321 a week, rising yearly based on expertise; therapeutic foster carers with advanced training can receive up to £575 per week. Article dated 20 June 2021, so figures may be out of date; a May 2023 article on the same site says 'up to £35,900 per year, per child'. The main allowance page gives no weekly figure (calculator only). Page does not state a fee/allowance split.
depends_on: Carer's expertise/years (yearly rise); where you live; child's age; special needs; therapeutic training
quote: our allowances start from £321 a week, rising yearly based on expertise

name: By the Bridge (Cambian)
basis: ANNUAL ONLY, no weekly figure on the page: 'from £24,000* a year, tax free, Fostering one child', based on a child in place for 52 weeks (equivalent to a £29,440 taxed salary). Described as financial payments covering the costs of caring for a child plus a professional fee. Dividing by 52 would give about £461 per week but the page does not state that.
depends_on: Type of fostering approved for; child's age (older child = higher professional fee and pay)
quote: Typically a Foster Parent could earn from £24,000* a year, tax free, Fostering one child.

name: Match Foster Care
basis: ANNUAL ONLY, no weekly fee stated: 'around £25,000 per year for caring for a teenager', most or all tax-free. The only weekly figures on the page (£375/£450) are HMRC tax relief amounts, not pay. Page does not say whether the figure includes the child's allowance.
quote: you can expect to earn around £25,000 per year for caring for a teenager
